function.arguments: {"index": 2, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The data dictionary confirms that `sample_seq` indicates assay run number, and a patient who was re-tested appears twice. This ensures one row per patient and prevents double-weighting of re-tested individuals in any analysis."}
